summary.text: Brad Halbrook is a Republican member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 107th District, listed by the Illinois General Assembly as serving from April 2012 to January 2015 and again since January 2017.

paragraphs.text: Halbrook's legislature biography says Halbrook was appointed to the House in April 2012, was born in Pana, Illinois, and is a diversified farmer and small business owner.
It says Halbrook previously served as a Beef Association board member.
